name: resume-claim-verification
description: Review resume claims against available evidence and create a neutral, beginner-friendly PDF report for human review.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based resume review without binary verdicts
interface.longDescription: Review employment, education, project, authorship, technology, responsibility, and impact claims. Produce a cited PDF with clear percentages, alternative explanations, and focused follow-up questions for a human reviewer.
defaultPrompt: Review this resume claim by claim and create a PDF report.
Check this resume and its supplied portfolio links.
Turn these resume claims into focused interview questions.
